name: ouat178-k27-test-vol-ids-uat
description: OUAT-178 no-deploy test: adds vol ids CM QW K27.Z26 and CM SB K27.Z26 (copies of the K27.K27 rows, expiry 2026-12-15) so the current engine prices the K27 spread to 15 Dec. The derived bbg ids stay QWK7 / SBK7. Insert only, test data, remove with the undo rule after the check.

steps.where: tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND created_by = 'ouat178-test' AND vol_id IN ('CM QW K27.Z26', 'CM SB K27.Z26')

source.sql: SELECT asset_class, replace(vol_id, 'K27.K27', 'K27.Z26') AS vol_id, product_code, bbg_opt_ticker, DATE '2026-12-15' AS expiry_date, underlying_id FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND vol_id IN ('CM QW K27.K27', 'CM SB K27.K27')
